name: nll_loss2d
description:
Negative log likelihood loss for a 4D input (N, C, H, W) of log-probabilities
and a 3D integer target (N, H, W). Returns only the loss tensor, applying the
requested reduction (none/mean/sum) with optional per-class weights and an
ignore_index. Representative native ABI: aten::nll_loss2d(Tensor self, Tensor target, Tensor? weight=None, int reduction=1, SymInt ignore_index=-100) -> Tensor. The restored latest-master suite also differentiates this combined loss with respect to self for mean/sum, weighted/unweighted inputs and floating dtypes; preserve that autograd contract. This is not nll_loss2d_forward, which returns loss and total_weight, and is not the lower-level nll_loss2d_backward API requiring grad_output and total_weight. The benchmark measures the combined forward loss only. Original test parameters, reduction scaling and comparison tolerances remain authoritative.
